# Type.TableColumn

```m
Type.TableColumn(tableType as type, column as text) as type
```

Returns the type of the column `column` in the table type `tableType`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `tableType` | `type` | no |
| `column` | `text` | no |
